learning_outcomes.text: Recognize the potential benefits of data processing in engineering.
Realistically assess the strengths and weaknesses of digital computers, operating systems, and programs.
Map complex technical systems into models and verify their completeness and correct function.
Understand aspects of real-time, security, and reliability in technical systems.
Formulate and document small problem solutions algorithmically (language-independent).
Implement small algorithms into executable programs in the C programming language.
Thoroughly test programs for correct function.
Test and improve program behavior in case of incorrect operation.
Know potential weaknesses in mapping scientific quantities to digital computers.
Have an increased sense of responsibility regarding software in technical systems (relevance: health, life).
Be able to efficiently use a common engineering tool.
Develop, practically implement, and test small models, critically questioning the results.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Data Processing for Engineers
Basic components and architecture of computers
Mapping objects of engineering thought to real computers (integers, floating-point numbers, structures)
Mapping solution paths to algorithms, documentation
Representation and simulation of concurrent technical processes
Automaton diagrams as a model for technical automata
Real-time aspects
Potential and dangers of network operation in technical systems
Algorithms, procedural approach, structograms
Fundamentals, statements, assignments, inputs and outputs
Conditional statements
Loops, arrays, file access
Subroutines, functions
Pointers, structures
Semester-long exercises adapted to knowledge level
Insight: event-driven program flow (windowing systems)
Introduction to MATLAB
Script file programming
Graphical results display
Graphical user interface: Simple model building, transformations and useful visualization
assessment_rules: The overall module grade is based on a single written exam of 120 minutes, contributing 100% to the final grade.
